title: TD 100 experiment on a woman on film

tellings.quote: an experiment on a woman. There's no sound, but it's obvious what's happening. You can see, you know, she's in the other room. She's behind a wall. They're in the other room. He has his device that he invented in the early '60s called the TD 100, which I've told

plain: Silent film from the early 1960s at a company called Intelectron in New York shows an experiment on a woman: she sits behind a wall in one room while the experimenters work in another, using a device the inventor built and called the TD 100. A researcher named Greg Malatzi describes the footage to Michels, saying there is no sound "but it's obvious what's happening." If true, it would show a device acting on a person through a wall decades ago.
